title: Savings Calculator
description: Estimate your total savings and interest earned over time with monthly deposits.

article.heading: Overview
article.content: This savings calculator helps individuals and families estimate how much their savings will grow over time based on monthly contributions, interest rates, and saving duration. It’s ideal for planning long-term goals like retirement, education funds, or major purchases.

article.heading: What You’ll Learn
list: How monthly contributions and compounding interest affect total savings.
The formula for calculating the future value of savings.
The importance of consistent saving for long-term financial goals.

article.heading: How to Calculate Savings Growth
steps: Enter your monthly saving amount, annual interest rate, and duration in years.
Apply the formula: FV = P × [(1 + r/n)ⁿᵗ – 1] / (r/n).
The result shows your total accumulated savings, including interest earned.

article.heading: Why Regular Saving Matters
article.content: Regular saving builds discipline and financial stability. Even small monthly contributions can grow into a significant amount over time due to the power of compounding. This calculator helps visualize how steady saving leads to long-term financial independence.
